finding_history.description: One open-findings fingerprint (sorted open IDs joined with commas) per changes_requested review since findings last progressed

reason.description: Why the run is stopped; cleared when the run leaves the stopped state and at done

stop_kind.description: Stable classification of the current stop (ADR 0022); cleared with reason

stop_detail.description: Refines stop_kind: the approval checkpoint of an approval_gate, the failure category of an agent_failure (quota_exhausted, rate_limited, timeout, unavailable, authentication_error, invocation_error, protocol_error, interrupted, worktree_mutated, config_error, mixed, unknown), or the cause of a gate_failure (interrupted, start_failed, worktree_mutated)

unaccepted_head.description: Builder commit whose handoff failed validation (ADR 0019)

auto_resume_turn.description: Turn of the task run's last automatic resume under --auto-resume (ADR 0025); at most one automatic resume is allowed between two accepted handoffs

auto_resumes.description: Number of automatic resumes over the task run's life (ADR 0025)

roadmap_run_id.description: The roadmap run that started this task run, from FORGECYCLE_ROADMAP_RUN_ID (ADR 0026)

roadmap_task_id.description: The roadmap task this task run runs, from FORGECYCLE_ROADMAP_TASK_ID (ADR 0026)

roadmap_decisions.description: The task run's copy of its roadmap run's decisions.md, taken when it started and named in every turn manifest as ROADMAP_DECISIONS (ADR 0028)
